items.title: Chern classes of a perfect object are central and commute with bivariant classes

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extends centrality and commutation with bivariant classes from locally free modules to perfect objects whose Chern classes are defined (statement lines 9393-9404, tag 0F9F-adjacent). The proof reduces by the vanishing criterion to an integral base, uses the computation statement to represent the object by a bounded complex of finite locally free modules of constant rank, and then applies the commutation for locally free modules together with the polynomial construction of the Chern class of the complex. The reduction chain is the substance, so the claim is H2.
